senses.example: Alquilamos un piso en el centro.
senses.exampleGloss: We are renting a flat in the centre.
We live on the third floor.
senses.notes: Same word, second real meaning; kept separate so the senses do not merge.

alternatives.reason: Shared word in Spain, usually a rented or holiday flat; piso is the normal home.
Formal/administrative term covering houses and flats.

notes: Two senses are genuinely common in Spain (home and storey); both are A2 and worth teaching together.
